name: Junith Eruita

abilities.name: Acts of Faith
abilities.description: At the start of each phase, if you have not used an Act of Faith this phase, one unit from your army with this ability can use an Act of Faith. If it does, gain D3 Miracle dice.

abilities.name: Invulnerable Save
abilities.description: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

abilities.name: FLY
abilities.description: This model can move over models and terrain features as if they were not there when making a Normal Move, Advance, or charge move.

abilities.name: Vessel of the Emperor's Grace
abilities.description: At the start of your Command phase, if Junith Eruita is on the battlefield, gain D3 Miracle dice.

abilities.name: Beacon of Faith
abilities.description: While this model is leading a unit, each time an Act of Faith is used on a unit within 6" of this model, you can add 1 to the dice result.

abilities.name: Pulpit of Saint Holline's Basilica
abilities.description: Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY units within 6" of this model do not need to take Battleshock tests.

constraints.description: Junith Eruita is an Epic Hero and cannot be included more than once in your army.

notes: Junith Eruita rides the Pulpit of Saint Holline's Basilica, a hovering devotional platform, giving her the VEHICLE keyword despite being infantry-scale.
